edits.new: 4. ScreeningInputAssembler reads its inputs through their owners' contracts: the case facts, the open deviations, the ledger entries of the last 180 days, and the documents and their stored fields (DP-01, DP-18; AC1, AC5). Every source field is taken from the rwb-source-data contract under its contract field names; no SQL view or ACE table is read, and the boundary test fails the build on either. The document read is a contract dependency on rwb-document and the call-note read is a field of the rwb-source-data contract; both are confirmed with their owners before the shadow screening test. No copy of a document is held in schema rwb_deviation. The party-flag, deceased-marker and freshness fields are confirmed with P1 before the wave 2 system test.
